title: Proposal Microsite
subtitle: Turn a prospect brief into an interactive deal summary your client actually wants to read.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: Calloway Industries — company profile, stakeholder map, 4 pain points ($8.35M impact), proposed solution, 3-year ROI model (215%), 2 case studies, competitive context

learning_objectives: Attach a prospect brief and let the AI read every number — your job is persuasion strategy, not data lookup
Write the five things a data file cannot tell an AI: who is skeptical in the room, what hook opens the deal, which case study fits, which differentiator answers the objection, and what the CTA asks
Specify stakeholder cards and expandable interactions in the prompt so your first build is already a sales tool — not a static page
Iterate with precision: name the single most important gap in your first output and fix only that in one follow-up
Deliver a self-contained HTML proposal microsite a sales rep can open on a laptop in any client meeting — no server, no install, no dependencies
